say:1:1430223101:1.text: It's very important. For some nobles, a veil may be even more important than a dress.
say:1:1430223101:1.source_cn: 很重要，对于贵族们来说，面纱甚至比礼服还要重要。
say:1:1430223101:1.male: It's very important. For some nobles, a veil may be even more important than a dress.
say:1:1430223101:1.female: It's very important. For some nobles, a veil may be even more important than a dress.

say:2:1430223102:1.text: I'm willing to pay you double for it! Can you please give me this veil...?
say:2:1430223102:1.source_cn: 我愿意多加钱！能不能把这件面纱让给我……

say:4:1430223103:1.text: I can't! If I don't return with this veil, I'm as good as dead!
say:4:1430223103:1.source_cn: 不可能！要是买不到面纱，我的下场不会比你好！
